description: This file defines the RoutingTablePartition object and class, which manage routing information for edge partitions in Spark's GraphX. It includes methods for creating messages, building routing tables from messages, and iterating over vertices for edge partition routing.

classes.name: RoutingTablePartition
classes.description: Stores routing information for vertices across edge partitions, allowing iteration, reversal, and filtered processing of vertices based on their routing.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Encodes a vertex ID, partition ID, and position into a RoutingTableMessage.

methods.name: vidFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts the vertex ID from a RoutingTableMessage.

methods.name: pidFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts the partition ID from a RoutingTableMessage.

methods.name: positionFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts the position byte from a RoutingTableMessage.

methods.name: edgePartitionToMsgs
methods.description: Generates routing messages for each vertex in an edge partition.

methods.name: fromMsgs
methods.description: Constructs a RoutingTablePartition from a set of RoutingTableMessages.

methods.name: toBitSet
methods.description: Converts a vector of booleans into a BitSet.
